verdict.rationale: dlt is an open-source Python library (pip install) that runs entirely locally/self-hosted with no required cloud dependency — it can be deployed anywhere Python runs (laptop, Airflow, Lambda, containers) and used with local destinations like DuckDB, fully separate from the optional managed dltHub SaaS offering. Missing for 10: no explicit self-hosting guide/documentation distinct from dltHub cloud, and no independent hands-on report specifically confirming self-hosted production use.
